applies_to: group S3 of docs/budgets/owner_decisions/OWNER_QUESTIONS_SEQUENCED_v1.md (rows of owner_questions_state_v4) on execution branch claude/nifty-ramanujan-w68f9z

P1Q-02.summary: register max V_d, supply current limit, max attempt duration, max attempts, cool-down/reset before the first P1-S6 attempt, from the actual H-1, supply, isolation qualification, thermal limits and interlocks; V_d within the qualified H-1 operating/isolation envelope; current limit <= min(safe H-1 limit, lab supply capability, 8.33 A stand/supply ceiling); 8.33 A never I_d,max,H1; duration/retries never increased after an unsuccessful ignition

P1Q-03.summary: SUSTAINED only if supply enabled+connected, I_d above a pre-registered threshold over the measured P1-M-22 RF-on/plasma-off pickup/noise floor (from its level and uncertainty), continuously for a pre-registered minimum duration (from DAQ bandwidth and start-transient timescale, registered before P1-S6), not a spike/capacitive/RF-pickup/switching artifact, no invalidating interlock; values never chosen after seeing a run

P1Q-05.summary: >= 3 independent re-ignition attempts per candidate point for the P2 handoff, each from extinguished/RF-off, registered restart condition, same operating point, recorded independently; all attempts count, failures never discarded; repeatability evidence only, not a PASS by itself

P1Q-06.summary: P1-S3..S5: F6 = magnet OFF baseline first, then registered H-1 magnet setting(s); coil currents/field-setting ids recorded for every magnet-on record; fringe-field influence never assumed negligible until measured

P1Q-07.summary: dedicated H-1 + C1 characterization in the registered HI-AR envelope registers I_d,max,H1,Ar (max measured I_d inside the qualified envelope, with uncertainty), frozen before P1-S7 and used by P1-S7 ICP-45A (never 8.33 A); Ar value is an engineering reference only; a flight-relevant I_d,max,H1 is registered separately on N2/O2/O or delivered propellant and never alters the historical Ar result

P1Q-08.summary: P1-S0..S5 in the HI-ENG / HI-S1A envelope; HI-HOLDOUT-A required immediately before the first Hall-on reading at P1-S6; nothing from S0..S5 consumes or contaminates the held-out partition

P1Q-19.summary: before the first P1-S7 point u_I_e,registered >= u(I_e,cap)_channels under the registered covariance treatment; otherwise ICP-45 is NOT_EVALUATED_REGISTRATION; never silently replaced by the larger value; correctable before acquisition from calibration evidence, never after the result

P1Q-24.summary: k_loss = 2.0 for the at-power RF loss-model verification in P1 and P2 (CAL-P2-09/10): |eta_meas - eta_pred| / u_c <= 2, never relaxed separately; consistent with k_x = 2; until it passes P_delivered is an upper bound / unverified-loss quantity and C_e an upper-bound quantity; small-signal S-parameters alone never verify the loss model; a failure is investigated, never widened

OQ-RFQV2-09.summary: P1-S6 may run with C1 physically absent (electrical and gas connections absent/open and documented), recorded as C1_NOT_INSTALLED; HE-L10/11/12 stay LATER for P1-S6 but are scheduled against the S3.5 H-1 reference characterization gate (needed before I_d,max,H1,Ar and P1-S7)

OQ-RFQV2-10.summary: dedicated H-1 build-to-print fabrication RFQ (channel/body, anode + distributor/plenum, gas-path interfaces, ceramics, MC-1 magnetic-circuit parts, coil formers/winding, thermal/mechanical mounts, feedthrough provisions, dimensional inspection, material certs), not inside the ICP mechanical RFQ; design authority, magnetic/channel/anode design, interfaces, configuration control, final integration, instrumentation, acceptance testing stay in-house; quotation/specification only, no purchase order

recorder_notes: the only numerical value set by this record is k_loss = 2.0 (owner-supplied); start-attempt limits, sustained-discharge threshold/duration and I_d,max,H1,Ar remain registrations from real hardware before P1-S6 / P1-S7
S3.5 introduces two distinct quantities: I_d,max,H1,Ar (engineering reference, P1-S7) and a later flight-relevant I_d,max,H1
